name: WRAPPER_GUARD_AUDIT_APPEND
rationale: Append non-blocking wrapper guard audit for canonical root/python/env observability

operations.text:
# PATCH_V2_GUARD_AUDIT_BEGIN
try {
  $__tbot_v2_root   = 'C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED'
  $__tbot_v2_legacy = 'C:\alpaca-bot\org_bot'
  $__tbot_v2_py     = 'C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED\code\.venv\Scripts\python.exe'
  $__tbot_v2_log    = 'C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED\runtime\paper\logs\hardening_events.jsonl'

  $__tbot_v2_row = [ordered]@{
    ts                     = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
    kind                   = "wrapper_guard_audit_v2"
    wrapper                = "ORG_UNIFIED_RUNTIME_MANAGER.ps1"
    canonical_root         = $__tbot_v2_root
    canonical_root_exists  = (Test-Path $__tbot_v2_root)
    canonical_python       = $__tbot_v2_py
    canonical_python_exists= (Test-Path $__tbot_v2_py)
    legacy_root            = $__tbot_v2_legacy
    current_script         = $PSCommandPath
    current_location       = (Get-Location).Path
    path_looks_legacy      = [bool](($PSCommandPath -as [string]) -like "*C:\alpaca-bot\org_bot*")
    env_pythonpath         = $env:PYTHONPATH
    env_tbot_runroot       = $env:TBOT_RUNROOT
  }

  $__tbot_v2_dir = Split-Path -Parent $__tbot_v2_log
  if ($__tbot_v2_dir) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $__tbot_v2_dir | Out-Null
  }

  ($__tbot_v2_row | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10) |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $__tbot_v2_log -Encoding UTF8
} catch {
  # best-effort only
}
# PATCH_V2_GUARD_AUDIT_END
